title: All-in-One Fantasy Life Sim
description:
Your adventure is entirely your own. Become part of a vast and magical world called Eden, where you can be anything.

🎮 Current Version: V2.1

Update
[May 12, 25] V2.1: added races.
[Oct 12, 25]: released Auto-Cards version.

📜 GUIDES 📜
1️⃣ Fill the Plot Essentials with your character's information (appearance, personality, background, talent, ability, etc.)
2️⃣ Fill the Author's Note with your plot (desired genre, event, mission, etc.)
3️⃣ Keep the memory of NPCs you like by creating story cards about them.
4️⃣ Feel free to modify everything however you want.

🕹 BASIC VERSION
Efficient story cards triggering made for free-players. ±130 story cards can be triggered.

⚠️ FULL VERSION
Export the story cards and re-import them. Every SC will automatically receive a trigger.

Check out the scenario from my profile.

prompt: Eden was once a united world. All races thrived under the guidance of ancient deities. However, this unity was shattered by the Abyssal Rupture, a devastating event unleashed by the archdemons—rulers of the Abyss. Their influence fractured the bonds between races and engulfed the world in destruction. As the survivors fled to rebuild in the aftermath, Eden splintered into numerous kingdoms. Each are carving out its own dominion in a fractured world, struggling to hold on to what remained of the past.

cardPool.title: Eden and the Abyssal Rupture
cardPool.value:
Eden is a vast and magical world shaped by ancient deities. Elysium (heaven) embodies heavenly harmony, while the Abyss (hell, underworld) represents chaos.

Eden was once a united world, where all races thrived under the watchful guidance of ancient deities. However, this unity was shattered by Abyssal Rupture.

The Abyssal Rupture, a catastrophic event unleashed by the Archdemons, tore Eden apart. It shattered racial unity, wrought destruction, and corrupted landscapes into lifeless wastelands. Ancient mana became unstable, civilization collapsed, and Eden fragmented into struggling kingdoms. Survivors adapted amid chaos, forging new ways of life, while the lingering Abyssal influence continues to manifest in shadowed remnants across the land.
